# ShopLoop dataset — data dictionary

**ShopLoop** is a fictional Amazon-like online marketplace. All data is generated by `week1/00_Setup`
(fixed random seeds: every trainee gets exactly the same data) into
`/Volumes/workspace/de_training/raw/landing/`.

## Sources (files)

| Folder | Format | Generator | Arrives | Rows |
|--------|--------|-----------|---------|------|
| `customers/customers.csv` | CSV | `write_customers()` | once | 120 |
| `products/products.csv` | CSV | `write_products()` | once | 26 |
| `orders/orders_batch_NNN.csv` | CSV | `write_orders_batch(n)` | one file per day (batch 1 = 2026-11-01) | ~251 |
| `reviews/reviews_batch_NNN.json` | JSON Lines, nested | `write_reviews_batch(n)` | one file per day | 60 |

### customers
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| customer_id | string | `C0001`… |
| first_name, last_name | string | |
| email | string | **empty for some customers** (every 37th) |
| country | string | PT, ES, FR, DE, IT, UK |
| city | string | |
| is_prime | boolean | Prime-like membership |
| signup_date | date | 2023–2025 |

### products
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| product_id | string | `P001`… |
| product_name | string | |
| category | string | Electronics, Books, Home & Kitchen, Sports, Toys, Beauty |
| brand | string | fictional brands |
| list_price | decimal | |

### orders (one row = one order line)
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| order_id | string | `O` + batch + sequence, e.g. `O00100042` |
| customer_id | string | **empty in 1 row per file** |
| order_ts | timestamp | within the batch day |
| product_id | string | FK → products |
| quantity | int | **negative in 1 row per file** |
| unit_price | decimal | **empty in 1 row per file** |
| discount_pct | int | 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 |
| status | string | delivered / shipped / cancelled / returned / pending, **with inconsistent casing** (`Delivered`, `DELIVERED`) |
| channel | string | web, app, marketplace |

Each file also contains **one duplicated line**.

Revenue rule (gold): `net_amount = quantity × unit_price × (1 − discount_pct/100)`, only for
`delivered` and `shipped`.

### reviews (JSON, nested)
```json
{"review_id": "R0030000", "product_id": "P024", "rating": 3, "title": "Excellent",
 "review_ts": "2026-11-03T10:22:36", "verified_purchase": true,
 "reviewer": {"customer_id": "C0074", "country": "UK", "is_prime": false},
 "tags": ["would buy again", "as described"], "helpful_votes": 12, "language": "pt"}
```
- `reviewer` is a **struct**, `tags` an **array** (→ `explode`).
- `language` only appears **from batch 3 on** (schema evolution exercise, day 4).

## Tables built during week 1 (`workspace.de_training`)

| Layer | Tables |
|-------|--------|
| Bronze | `bronze_orders` (COPY INTO, incremental), `bronze_customers`, `bronze_products` |
| Silver | `silver_orders` (clean, typed, deduplicated, net_amount), `silver_customers`, `silver_products` |
| Gold | `gold_daily_revenue` (date × country × category), `gold_top_products` (with return rate) |
| Other | `customers` (notebook 02 demo), `sdp_*` (bonus declarative pipeline) |
